ownership_comparison_scope: A missing newly attributed service makes root+decoder aggregate comparison incomplete; preexisting services may be reused and are excluded. Never infer decoder RSS is absent or unchanged. Matching two-process cardinality is temporal evidence only, not proof of exclusive XPC ownership. No shared service was terminated to force freshness.
scope: Root/descendant RSS is separate from temporally attributed VT service RSS. No exclusive XPC ownership or leak causality follows. RSS may double-count shared pages. PID/executable sample identities do not detect same-executable PID reuse. Whole-minute and nominal checkpoint windows are approximate: app and sampler have distinct clocks. Category medians do not necessarily sum to the median of the total. No vmmap/sample/heap/GPU allocation observations were taken.
